questions.question: How should you read the text of a Messages API response in Python?
options: Loop over response.content and read block.text only when block.type == "text"
questions.explanation: response.content is a list of blocks of different types; check the type before reading text.

questions.question: Your reply ends abruptly and stop_reason is "max_tokens". What does this mean?
options: The output hit the max_tokens limit and is incomplete
The input prompt was too long
The model finished its answer naturally
questions.explanation: max_tokens means the cap was reached and the reply was cut off; end_turn indicates a natural finish.

questions.question: How do you continue a multi-turn conversation with the Claude API?
options: Pass a conversation ID returned by the previous call
Send only the newest user message; the API remembers the rest
End the messages list with a partial assistant turn
Resend the full message history, starting with a user message, on every call
questions.explanation: The API is stateless, so the full history must be sent each time; prefill is not supported on current models.

questions.question: On claude-opus-5-5, how do you make the model spend less effort thinking on a simple task?
questions.explanation: Current models use adaptive thinking controlled by effort; thinking cannot be disabled on claude-opus-5-5 and sampling parameters are rejected.
